issues.description: Rideable.messageOnRide is specified in the problem statement/UML as a no-argument method returning a String, and the required output format is exactly "Riding on [Animal Type] [name]". However, the solution repository defines Rideable.messageOnRide(String equipment) and implements the parameterized signature in Pig and Seal, producing output that includes the equipment. This makes the reference solution/API inconsistent with the assignment spec and would cause student implementations following the spec to not match the solution/tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution match the spec: change Rideable to `String messageOnRide();` and update Pig/Seal to implement `messageOnRide()` returning exactly `"Riding on [Animal Type] " + getName()`. If the equipment parameter is intended instead, update the UML, written requirements (including the required string), and any template usages accordingly.
